req.title: Session cookie has HttpOnly attribute
req.statement: The system shall set HttpOnly on the session cookie.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the session cookie must have the HttpOnly attribute set for security reasons. This ensures that the cookie cannot be accessed via JavaScript, mitigating certain types of attacks such as XSS. The test suite will verify this behavior by checking the presence of the HttpOnly attribute in the session cookie under different scenarios.

tests.name: test_session_cookie_httponly_positive
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in with valid credentials
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Check if the session cookie has HttpOnly attribute
assert r.status_code == 302
assert 'Set-Cookie' in r.headers
cookie_header = r.headers['Set-Cookie']
assert 'HttpOnly' in cookie_header

tests.name: test_session_cookie_httponly_negative
actions: Attempt to access session cookie via JavaScript
expected: Session cookie cannot be accessed via JavaScript
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Log in with valid credentials
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})

# Attempt to access session cookie via JavaScript (simulated)
try:
    cookie_header = r.headers['Set-Cookie']
    assert 'HttpOnly' in cookie_header
    # Simulate JavaScript access attempt
    js_accessible = 'document.cookie' in cookie_header
    assert not js_accessible
except KeyError:
    assert False, 'Set-Cookie header missing'
